title: THE AIRLOCK
briefing: ARGUS's last stand is an orbital airlock. In phase 0 the inner door is open and the chamber must be fully pressurised (4 units of air); in phase 1 the outer door is open to space and the chamber must be empty. Venting dumps the air and swings the doors; repressurising does the reverse. Any other combination of door and air is a meltdown.

intro: MY LAST FACILITY. IN ORBIT. OUT OF YOUR REACH.
TWO DOORS. TWO TRUTHS. YOUR LITTLE AND CANNOT HOLD BOTH.

default: The airlock lives in two different moods. Describe each one on its own.

Two AND blocks, one per phase, joined by OR.
